book.name: Ibulu
book.title: Ŋwa wù ba gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Ba'ibulu le

content: Kune chiji kintanyɛ wù Mɛlkisɛdɛk

Mɛlkisɛdɛk wunɛ gɛ̀ bee Nfoŋ wu Salɛm, wu ka nyu chiji kintanyɛ ki Nyo wù le Kikwɛɛ ki Mwɛɛ Munchii. Lɛ to nyu kife kimu le, Ablaham la jɛŋ wu so banfoŋ bamu. Mɛlkisɛdɛk gɛ̀ tasɛ bɛ wu no wu gɛ̀ kwɛɛde, wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi ye ye le.

Ablaham gadɛ mwɛɛ mù wu loh gwɛŋ wu jɛŋ le bimbe yuufe, wu nya kimbe kimimia ki mwɛɛ munchii Mɛlkisɛdɛk le. Chiji kintanyɛ wunɛ jee che duunyi mwɛɛ munfɛɛ. Fi fwe le lɛ wu le, “Nfoŋ wu Chaaŋ.” Jee che chimi nyu lɛ, “Nfoŋ wu Nyiɛgee” nje wù gɛ̀ bee Nfoŋ wu Salɛm.
Gɛ muh kee chiji kɛnɛ bwee kɛnɛ kinyii ke gɛ. Gɛ kinche ke kɛme fɛŋkɛɛ kɛnɛ fɛkimɛsɛ gɛ. Wu le chiji kintanyɛ wù kage gɛ njɛ Mwa Nyo.

Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh wù gɛ̀ bee wunɛ! Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wù kuge. Mo Ablaham wù gɛ̀ bee chiji kfuu chi bamii ba Ishwala, wù gɛ̀ loh mwɛɛ gwɛŋ wu jɛŋ le wu to bɛ mu wu gadɛ bimbe yuufe, wu nya kimimia wu le.

Fì kune booŋ ba Lɛwe ba to ba lɛne lɛme chi bachiji kintanyɛ, kijusɛ kimu jɛme a banchi ba Musɛ le lɛ bo fîi mwɛɛ a bamii ba Ishwala le kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe, mo no bamii banɛ gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba bwee baboo, bo bachii nyu booŋ ba Ablaham.

Gɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk wunɛ gɛ̀ bee muh wu a kinyi ki Lɛwe le gɛ. Geenɛ, gɛ̀ fi wu mwɛɛ a Ablaham le kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe, wu noŋ kimbonɛ yi ye ye le, Ablaham nyu muh wù Nyo gɛ̀ ge ŋka fɛ wu le.
Gɛ nyu kimaŋe lɛ muh wù nooŋ kimbonɛ yi muh mu le, kuge wu fede muh wù wu nooŋ kimbonɛ yi ye ye le gɛ.

Bachiji kintanyɛ ba a kfuu chi Lɛwe le banɛ, fii mwɛɛ a bamii le kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe, bo bayu bò fii nyu bamii ba taŋlo bo kwe. Geenɛ, Mɛlkisɛdɛk wù gɛ̀ fi mwɛɛ kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe a Ablaham le, Ŋwa wu Nyo sɛŋe besabɛŋ le lɛ, wu baaŋ yu.
Taŋlo ba du lɛ Lɛwe kibɛɛ wù kfuu che fii mwɛɛ a bamii le kimbe kimimia antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe wu gɛ̀ nya mwe mwɛɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk le chiaaŋ yi Ablaham le.
Bo taŋlo bo duu noo nje sege Mɛlkisɛdɛk gɛ̀ tasɛ bɛ Ablaham, wu wù Lɛwe gɛ̀ bee wu baaŋ bvulɛ bvu Ablaham wù gɛ̀ bee chiji bachiji bo.

Nɛ bee lɛ lɛme chì kfuu chi Lɛwe gee njɛ bachiji kintanyɛ le chi kojɛ ki chi gê bamii nyûme chaaŋ a Nyo jii, tu ntaŋ wu chiji kintanyɛ wumu le la? Besabɛŋ kee lɛ Nyo gɛ̀ nya banchi bamii ba Ishwala le, wu bii lɛme chi bachiji kintanyɛ ba a kfuu chi Lɛwe le gee. Fi doo fi nyume noo, bo ka bo jɛmɛ lɛ wuwɛɛ chiji kintanyɛ kɛme ki wu nyûme a je yì Mɛlkisɛdɛk le, fede ki wu nyûme a je yì chiji kintanyɛ ki a kfuu chi Aloŋ le nɛɛ?
Fi le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ kfuu chi bachiji kintanyɛ kusɛ, fi nyû chuule lɛ ba kɛme ki ba kûsɛ tɛ banchi.
Muh wunɛ wù ba jɛme kune wu, wu gɛ̀ bu a kfuu chimi le yeye, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ wu bu a kfuu chiyu le wù lɛ̂ne fɛ kitana ki kintanyɛ le gɛ.
Muh wunɛ le Tada wese besabɛŋ. Fi le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ wu gɛ̀ bu a kfuu chi Juda le. Musɛ gɛ̀ baaŋ a yugɛ wu jɛmɛ fiɛɛ kune kfuu chinɛ sege wu gɛ̀ jɛme kune bachiji kintanyɛ gɛ.
Jiso le chiji kintanyɛ a je yi Mɛlkisɛdɛk le
Fiɛɛ finɛ fì ba jɛme kune fi, le fi dunyɛ ye chuule no chiji kintanyɛ wumu le wu bu wa njɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛk.
Wu le wu ja wu tu chiji kintanyɛ ya nyume gɛ a je yì nchi jɛme le lɛ muh kɛmɛ ki wu nyûme a kfuu chi bachiji kintanyɛ le gɛ. Wu le chiji kintanyɛ nyu yi bvuŋga bvu kinche kì kage gɛ le.
Le fiɛɛ fì ba le ba saŋ kune wu lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le chiji kintanyɛ wù kage gɛ a je yì Mɛlkisɛdɛk le.”

content: Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, je yì kege yì bo gɛ̀ gee mwɛɛ yu ba le ba kɛŋsɛ wa yiyɛɛ, nje gɛ yi ka kɛme bvuŋga kɛnɛ lɛme gɛ.

Gɛ banchi ba Musɛ gɛ̀ to bo ge fiɛɛ fì joŋ fi gɛɛŋ fi mɛsɛ gɛ. Geenɛ mɛɛse Nyo le wu dunyɛ wa je yì joŋe chuule yì besabɛŋ le be gɛ̂ɛde bvufee yi le, fede yɛɛ. Le yi yì besabɛŋ fede yi le fɛ bee tôo mbebe yi Nyo le.
Ki ka ntaa fo, Nyo gɛ̀ doo wu gɛɛde chiji kintanyɛ wunɛ a je yì fiɛŋ yinɛ le, wu ji leh, gɛ wu gɛ̀ to wu ji leh sege wu gɛ̀ gɛɛde bamu baa gɛ.
Geenɛ, sege wu gɛ̀ gɛɛde wunɛ, wu ji leh kune wu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: gɛ mɛ nyu nto ŋkusɛ jɛ yaŋ gɛ,
‘Wo le chiji kintanyɛ wù kage gɛ.’”

content: Leh wù Nyo gɛ̀ ji wunɛ gɛ̀ duunyi lɛ Jiso le muh wù ge maŋkaŋ mà manfɛŋ manɛ mo lɛme, mo tɛɛme mo fede mà kege.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba gɛ̀ bee fweele bo gɛ̀ shee bo duude lo, nje gɛ kwe gɛ taŋlo yi chinɛ muh le wu mɛ gɛh wu gee lɛme che chi chiji kintanyɛ gɛ.
Geenɛ, Jiso le fie chiji kintanyɛ segechii, nje gɛ kinche ke nyu ki yu ki to ki ka gɛ.
Noo, taŋlo wu bvûuse bamii segechii ba kɛɛŋse ba too fɛ Nyo le, bo fede ye ye le. Wu bvuuse noo, nje wu le yu segechii ki wu lɛ̂ge Nyo fɛ bo le.

Fi le chuule lɛ besabɛŋ kɛ̂me kfuu chi kɛɛ kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ. Wu le fie muh wù yuude, gɛ wu kɛme jialɛ gɛ kɛnɛ ŋgilɛ ye ye le gɛ. Wu lɛme fie yeye fɛ bamii ba befe le. Nyo le wu bɛɛŋsɛ wa wu, wu bɛɛŋ wu fe kibvulɛ wu gɛɛŋ fɛwe.

Gɛ wu kɛme fie ntaŋ ki wu gêe kintanyɛ njɛ bikwɛɛ bi bachiji kintanyɛ, bò gee kintanyɛ aju achii. Bo doo bo gee bo ya bo ge fɛ bikwɛɛ biboo le, fɛ bo gêe fɛ bi bamii bamu le. Wu gɛ̀ ge fie ke kintanyɛ kimimia no wu gɛ̀ nya kikwɛɛ ke ki wu tânyɛ bamii yu.

Yi kife ki banchi ba Musɛ le, ba gɛ̀ baade bikwɛɛ bi bachiji kintanyɛ nyu bamii ba wɛɛyi yi nyaŋ yi ye le. Geenɛ, lɛ doo nyume a jiŋ a banchi banɛ, Nyo ge ŋka wu ji leh, wu mo wu baa wa nyu Mwa ye wù wu gɛ̀ ge wu kojɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu mɛsɛ wu kage gɛ.

footnotes.text: Ablaham gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ ki wu sûuŋ Lod chiaaŋ yi banfoŋ baa le.
Salɛm le lɛ, “Nyiɛgee” le jee chi a kilaantɛŋ ki Yɛlusalɛm le, bo sunɛ lo chi.
